title: Is There Any Sorrow Like My Sorrow

request.style: English, Byzantine lamentation for Good Friday, a sorrowful women's choir over a deep male drone, a solo voice sobbing out long melismas, no instruments, plagal mode, grave and still, 50 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Is it nothing to you, all you who pass by
Look and see
Is there any sorrow like my sorrow
That was brought upon me

[Verse]
For these things I weep
My eyes flow down with tears
For the comforter is far from me
The one who should restore my soul

[Chorus]
Look and see, look and see
Is there any sorrow like my sorrow

[Verse]
My children are desolate
For the enemy has prevailed
Zion stretches out her hands
And there is none to comfort her

[Chorus]
Look and see, look and see
Is there any sorrow like my sorrow
